about: M1 (From dispatch to locational prices). Prairie Town's fleet from lesson 0 (town.json) on lesson 0's real day, 3 September 2025 (Southwest Power Pool shapes from EIA-930 in town_year.json, cut and scaled exactly as assets/learn/grid-operator.js prepare() does; _tests/learn/test_m01-dispatch-to-lmp.js checks the arrays below against it). Part A solves the day on one bus; part B places the plants on three buses joined by three lines of equal reactance (DC power flow). Plant sizes, costs, the network and every line limit are illustrative. The reference block is a precomputed solve (110 MW case, labelled precomputed on the page); the Node test re-solves it.

day.label: 3 September 2025
day.units: MW, hour by hour (local time, Central daylight time)

units_note: b is the line's susceptance in MW per radian (1/x on a 100 MVA base with x = 0.1 per unit), equal on all three lines; flow = b x (angle difference).
